worldcombat.skill.snore.summary: Usable only while asleep: spits a snore at the target for special damage and a chance to flinch. Echo splits it into two lighter snores. The deeper the sleep, the louder and farther it carries.
worldcombat.skill.snore.use.1: Fluster a foe that closed in and buy time to wake
worldcombat.skill.snore.use.2: Roll the flinch twice with Echo
worldcombat.skill.snore.description.0: Each snore deals about %1$s power; one cast has %2$s segments, settled one by one.
worldcombat.skill.snore.description.1: The snore carries %1$s blocks and is %2$s blocks wide; the first foe on the line is the one hit.
worldcombat.skill.snore.description.2: Each landing has a %1$s flinch chance for %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.snore.echo.on: Echo on: two snore segments, each about 22%% less power and its own flinch roll, but a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.snore.echo.off: Echo off: one louder, heavier snore that is cheaper and rolls the flinch once.
worldcombat.skill.snore.timing: Cast at a foe within %1$s blocks (only while asleep); after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.snore.growth.0: At level %1$s the snore rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.snore.growth.1: At level %1$s the snore rises to %2$s power, %3$s blocks of range, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
On: two snore segments, each about 22%% less power with its own flinch roll, but a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off: one louder, heavier and cheaper snore.
worldcombat.skill.snore.preference.ai.ma: While asleep the companion only snores at a threat this close; lower sleeps more and acts less, higher hits whatever is in reach.
